title: Voice of Customer  Empathy Grid
prompt:
PROMPT — COPY & PASTE READY
Act as a customer research analyst using the Empathy Grid.
Customer profile  :  [ROLE, INDUSTRY, COMPANY SIZE]
Problem context   :  [WHAT CHALLENGE THEY FACE DAILY]
Real customer data (if available):
[PASTE REVIEWS, INTERVIEW NOTES, OR SUPPORT TICKETS]
Map the full Empathy Grid:
THINKS & FEELS  :  Inner concerns, hopes, and worries
SEES                       :  What their environment looks like
HEARS                    :  What colleagues, managers, media tell them
SAYS & DOES        :  Public behaviour and statements
PAINS                     :  Frustrations, fears, obstacles
GAINS                     :  Desired outcomes and measures of success
After the grid: give me 5 exact phrases this customer would use to describe their
problem in their own words, not marketing language.
